description: REQUIRES prior fourinsure__session__login call with same account_link_id. List civil receipt history. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

frst_reg_str_dt.description: 조회 시작일(접수일 기준) frstRegStrDt. YYYY-MM-DD 또는 YYYYMMDD. 비우면 기관 기본 기간(최근 7일)
